groups.operation: Call ucl_parser_free before returning from the add-string error branch.
groups.condition: ucl_parser_get_error reports an error after string parsing.
groups.capability: Release the parser and its owned state.
groups.consequence: Returning without ucl_parser_free leaves parser resources allocated.
groups.equivalence_reason: All four describe the same error-path cleanup omission. They differ in their assessment of whether a triggering input is established, which does not change the hypothesis.

groups.operation: Enable saved-comment handling during string parsing.
groups.condition: The harness constructs the parser with flags 0 while the saved-comment mode uses UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
groups.capability: Reach the supported comment-saving behavior through the parser setup.
groups.consequence: Inputs cannot exercise saved-comment handling through that setup.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both concern reachability of the same parser mode. They differ in certainty about the flag's effect.

groups.operation: Release parser->last_comment when an orphan comment remains at parsing end or parser destruction.
groups.condition: A saved comment remains orphaned at either cleanup point.
groups.capability: Manage ownership across the terminal state-machine path and ucl_parser_free.
groups.consequence: An orphan comment may remain allocated or be released incorrectly.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: its combined terminal and destructor scope is broader than the destructor-only candidate.

groups.operation: Avoid a second release of a terminal orphan comment during parser destruction.
groups.condition: The terminal path has already released parser->last_comment before ucl_parser_free runs.
groups.capability: Keep the terminal release and destructor ownership consistent.
groups.consequence: A second release could cause a double free.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: its failure consequence is double release, distinct from missing cleanup.

groups.operation: Reach ucl_parser_free after a reported parse error with a pending parser->last_comment.
groups.condition: An error is reported while a saved comment remains pending.
groups.capability: Invoke the new destructor cleanup for that pending comment.
groups.consequence: The pending saved comment remains allocated when the harness returns early.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: the required state and cleanup are specific to a pending saved comment on the error path.

groups.operation: Release a saved, unattached parser->last_comment during ucl_parser_free.
groups.condition: Parser destruction occurs while parser->last_comment remains set.
groups.capability: The destructor releases the unattached comment.
groups.consequence: The comment remains allocated after parser destruction.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns destructor cleanup specifically; the other orphan-comment candidate also covers terminal parsing cleanup.
